services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 7.1 in October 2026, it is modestly above its five-year norm; it has eased from 8.3 a month earlier but remains up from 5.8 three months ago and -24.2 six months ago. QLD coal saleable tonnes is the biggest positive contributor (+8.8), while NSW coal export value is the biggest negative (-6.7).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 41.5 in November, it is above its five-year norm and has risen from 37.0 a month ago and 10.7 six months ago, led by US new orders, iron & steel mills (+25.0 contribution) and offset most by inverted AUD/USD (-5.1). Baker Hughes North American and international rig-count values are blocked and reflect the last retrieved, rather than current, data.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of fitter/welder vacancy tightness and AUD/USD against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. The latest reading of -2.9 is slightly below its 5-year norm, improving from -13.6 a month ago and -24.1 three months ago; fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the largest positive contributor (+8.9), while AUD/USD is the largest negative (-11.9). Tungsten policy flags are excluded because they lack sufficient 5-year history.

technology.text: The pipeline holds 2 leads, 6 agreements, 1 cell ordered and 4 commissioned cells, with $7.2 million in stated contracted value, all unrecognised where stated. Over the past six months, it added these positions, including Komatsu’s $2.4 million first licensing agreement and operational first cell, a second Komatsu agreement and cell order, and a Metal 7 collaboration agreement.
